name: Ophel: arched corner block at the Southern Wall
notes: Tall ashlar block against the Southern Wall where the Ottoman wall meets it, two tall round-headed arches in its W face with dark depths, three small windows above them, plain upper masonry (K:032, K:044, K:038). Height: in K:044 (block 140 px tall, its top 40 px under the Southern Wall top line at the same depth) and K:032 (152 px, 50 px under) the top sits ~0.31 of the block's own height under the wall top; with the modelled wall top -26.5 and the ground at the W face ~-44.4 that is a top of -30.7, above the Ottoman wall top (-33.3..-35.5) as in K:038 and K:044. Wall ashlar, tint of the weathered medieval masonry.
